companies.name: Mysa
companies.description: B2B fintech platform automating accounts payable, invoice processing (Smart Scan), vendor payments, expense management and AI accounting reconciliation for mid-sized businesses
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.80). Shared terms: b2b, payment, account, payable. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: Bynow
companies.description: Saudi B2B fintech offering buy-now-pay-later for businesses, digitizing receivables and payables workflows and cash flow visibility for SMEs
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.61). Shared terms: b2b, payable. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: XSquare
companies.description: UAE-based fintech building a B2B payment orchestration platform that unifies multiple payment rails, collections, payments and reconciliation behind a single integration. It serves businesses, banks, government entities and large corporates, and partners with Mastercard to enable card-funded supplier and vendor payments that settle directly to bank accounts.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.56). Shared terms: b2b, payment, account. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: TranscendAP
companies.description: AI-driven accounts payable automation software for enterprise and mid-market AP teams
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.54). Shared terms: account, payable, automation. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: Causa Prima
companies.description: Causa Prima provides an agent-to-agent platform for enterprise finance teams that lets AI agents on both buyer and supplier sides resolve invoice disputes, negotiate payment terms and capture early-payment discounts. It connects companies on a shared network on top of existing ERP and accounting systems (SAP, Oracle, Xero, QuickBooks and others).
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.46). Shared terms: payment. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: Bloquo
companies.description: Bloquo is a Brazilian fintech providing stablecoin-based payment infrastructure that enables financial institutions and businesses to process international payments, manage liquidity, and settle transactions through APIs. Founded in 2024, it serves institutional clients and processes payments across borders.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.40). Shared terms: payment. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: Duqu
companies.description: Duqu is an Amsterdam-based fintech that gives small businesses and freelancers immediate short-term advances against their unpaid B2B invoices, without selling the invoice. It also offers its AI underwriting engine as a white-label credit-assessment tool to banks, lenders and leasing companies.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.40). Shared terms: b2b, small. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: OpenCFO
companies.description: OpenCFO provides a subscription-based, AI-native financial operations platform that unifies and automates accounts payable, accounts receivable and treasury workflows for mid-market companies operating across multiple entities, currencies and geographies. It connects ERP systems, bank portals, global payment rails and multi-currency treasury systems so finance teams can automate invoice processing, cross-border payments and reconciliation.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.39). Shared terms: payment, account, payable. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: Qashier
companies.description: Qashier sells a unified merchant operating system for small and medium-sized businesses in Southeast Asia, combining point-of-sale, payment acceptance, business management software, loyalty tools and embedded finance. Its customers are SMEs such as F&B, retail and beauty merchants across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and the Philippines.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.35). Shared terms: payment, small. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: Zalos
companies.description: Zalos builds Computer Agents for finance operations that log into existing ERP and finance systems (NetSuite, Sage, SAP, Oracle) via their user interfaces without APIs and automate accounts payable, billing, reconciliations and month-end close. It sells to midmarket and enterprise finance teams and CFOs.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.34). Shared terms: account, payable. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: Plinto
companies.description: Plinto builds AI agents that automate financial transaction checks for finance teams, integrating with ERP, banking, document and communication tools to detect discrepancies, query suppliers about incorrect invoices and prepare corrections. It sells to businesses with high transaction volumes, with paying customers and pilots in logistics, real estate, facility services and food production.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.34). Shared terms: no direct lexical overlap; inspect the product description for adjacent fit. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.

companies.name: Skydo
companies.description: Skydo is a Bengaluru-based cross-border payments platform for Indian exporters, MSMEs, freelancers and startups. It offers global collections, payouts, card acceptance, compliance automation and accounts receivable tools such as invoicing, payment reminders and accounting integration.
companies.similarityReason: Compared the companies' products and buyers with sentence embeddings (cosine 0.32). Shared terms: payment, account, automation. This is a similarity signal, not a funding prediction.
